stemMarkdown: By selling an article for Rs. 400.00, a shopkeeper incurs a loss of 20%. At what price (in Rs.) should he sell it to make a profit of 10%?
solutionMarkdown: A 20% loss means SP is $80\%$ of CP, so CP $= 400.00 \times \dfrac{100}{80} = 500$. For a 10% profit, SP $= 500 \times \dfrac{110}{100} = 550.0$.
